note.text: Symptom findings captured as discrete components during Dr. Webb's structured virtual assessment. The finding is correlated to tooth #19 both directly (Observation.bodySite) and to the patient-submitted intraoral photos (Observation.derivedFrom -> DocumentReference/documentreference-intraoral-photos). This derivedFrom link is the R4 work-around for the affected tooth: R4 DocumentReference has no bodySite element, so the tooth is carried on this coded Observation, letting the receiving PMS re-associate the photos to tooth #19. No LOINC code is asserted for the overall symptom finding (text-only components, per project verification discipline).
